gizmo.title: Partitur musik
gizmo.description: Nampilake lan muter partitur musik, tab gitar, lan notasi skor liwat alphaTex utawa MusicXML.

configure.title: Notasi AlphaTex
configure.description: Markup alphaTex sebaris kanggo partitur musik. Sunting langsung kanggo nulis notasi; disimpen ing template supaya spasi tetep.

configure.title: Berkas skor
configure.description: Unggah utawa pranalani berkas MusicXML (.xml/.musicxml/.mxl) utawa Guitar Pro (.gp3/.gp4/.gp5/.gpx/.gp). Ngganti alphaTex sebaris yen disetel.

advanced.title: Puter audio
advanced.description: Urip kanthi gawan - rungokake partitur musik sing diputer liwat synthesizer bawaan. Pateni kanggo mode tampilan wae (tanpa audio).

advanced.title: Tampilake pilihan tampilan
advanced.description: Tampilake tombol zoom, mulur, lan tata letak ing bilah pamuter.

advanced.title: Tampilake tombol ekspor
advanced.description: Tampilake tombol undhuh MIDI lan cithak/PDF ing bilah pamuter.
